description: Maison Skye & Rose Mid-Year 2026 Supplier New Arrivals

_schema._comment: POPULATE THIS FILE with the 31 supplier rows from the Mid-Year 2026 list. Five unisex fragrances appear under both L and M — include both rows for each. The ingestion script collapses the 31 rows to 26 unique identities.
_schema._supplierName: REQUIRED. Verbatim from the supplier catalogue. Never corrected, never normalised.
_schema._sourceReference: OPTIONAL. Row reference, e.g. 'Mid-Year 2026 Supplier List, Row 14'.
_schema._duplicateHandling: If the same fragrance appears under L AND M, include both rows with the same supplierName. The ingestion script collapses them into one identity with two SupplierIdentity entries.
